trap.see: Not every free neighbour is a good one to melt the clock with: the neighbour whose twin is buried deep would wait in the tray, so use the neighbours that go as a pair.

examples.text: Try 6 of campaign 9: the first losing move (free pair taken early, tile 51) was removal 3 of 80, at a designed trap; the loss (clock) showed 6 removals later.
